title: Bunny eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#e8e8f0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#d0d0e0'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='18' fill='#f0f0f8'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='13' fill='#e0e0f0'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='3' ry='13' fill='#ffb6c8'/>

  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>

  <polygon points='47,62 57,60 56,66 48,68' fill='#ffa94d'/>
  <!-- carrot lines -->
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='53' y2='72' stroke='#d96b00' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='49' y1='73' x2='52' y2='76' stroke='#d96b00' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- carrot greens -->
  <path d='M47 62 Q44 54 46 52' stroke='#3ccf5e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M49 61 Q49 53 51 51' stroke='#4ee06e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 61 Q55 54 56 53' stroke='#3ccf5e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='63' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0f0f8'/>
  <!-- right paw holding carrot -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='63' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0f0f8'/>

  <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e8e8f0'/>

  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#f8f8ff'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffc2d1' opacity='0.7'/>
